situation: A guy from another department asked me to dinner. He's nice but I'm not interested, and we'll keep running into each other at the coffee machine.
reply: That's really kind of you, and I'm flattered you asked. I don't see us that way, though, so I'll say no. I hope it doesn't make the coffee machine weird.
note: A clear no plus a light nod to the shared space lets you both carry on normally at work.

situation: 相亲认识的男生，见了三次面，人挺好，但我没感觉。他约我周末去看展。
reply: 谢谢你这几次的安排，和你聊天很舒服。我认真想了想，对我们之间没有那种感觉，不想拖着让你误会，所以周末就不去了。真心祝你一切顺利。
note: 不给理由清单，不说“以后再说”，含糊才是最伤人的。

situation: Après deux rendez-vous avec un gars rencontré sur une appli, je lui ai dit que je ne voulais pas continuer. Il m'envoie des messages pour avoir une autre chance.
reply: Je t'ai bien entendu, et je ne vais pas changer d'avis. Je vais arrêter de répondre maintenant, et je te souhaite le meilleur.
note: Une seule phrase calme pour clore, puis plus de réponse. S'il devient agressif, bloque-le, garde des captures d'écran et signale-le sur l'appli ; en cas de menace, appelle les secours.

situation: My friend Theo from our Thursday climbing group texted last night that he has feelings for me. I don't feel the same, but I really like him as a friend and want to keep climbing together.
reply: Theo, thank you for telling me, I know that took guts. I don't feel the same way, and I'd rather be straight with you than leave it hanging. I really value you as a friend and I'd love to keep climbing on Thursdays, but if you want to skip a few weeks first, that's completely fine.
note: Friendship is offered only because she genuinely wants it, and the space line lets him step back without it meaning anything.

situation: Been seeing Marcus for about 10 weeks. He's lovely but I'm just not feeling it. We have dinner booked Thursday and I don't want to do it there, so I'm calling him tonight. What do I actually say?
reply: Marcus, I want to be straight with you, because you deserve that. I've realised I'm not in this the way I'd want to be, and it isn't fair to either of us for me to keep going, so I don't think we should do dinner on Thursday. You've been really kind to me these last couple of months. I'm sorry.
note: After a couple of months, a call rather than a text, and before the booked dinner so he isn't told over a table he can't leave. If he asks why, it's fit, not a list.

situation: Matched with Sam on Hinge, we've been texting for five days, mostly about his sourdough disasters, and he just asked to meet for a drink Saturday. I've realised I'm not into it and we've never actually met.
reply: Hey Sam, thanks for asking, and I've enjoyed hearing about your sourdough disasters. I'm going to pass on meeting up though, I'm not feeling the spark I'd want before a first date. Good luck with the next loaf.
note: Before a first meeting, a short kind no beats ghosting; no reason needed beyond fit.

situation: Mi amiga Carla me presentó a su compañero de piso, Diego. El sábado hicimos una ruta de vermut por Malasaña y hoy me ha escrito para quedar otra vez. Es majo, pero no siento nada, y nos vamos a seguir viendo en los planes del grupo.
reply: Gracias por lo del sábado, Diego, me lo pasé bien y la ruta de vermut por Malasaña fue todo un acierto. Te soy sincera: no siento una conexión romántica, así que prefiero no quedar otra vez. Nos seguiremos viendo con Carla y el grupo, y por mi parte todo normal.
note: Con amigos en común: un no claro, sin lista de motivos, y una línea para que los planes de grupo sigan siendo cómodos. No se usa a Carla de mensajera.

situation: 相亲认识的男生，见了两次面，上周我跟他说没感觉，不继续了。今天他发微信问：'能告诉我到底哪里不好吗？我可以改。'
reply: 谢谢你这么坦诚地问。我觉得列一堆理由对我们俩都没什么帮助，真的不是你哪里做得不好需要改，只是我们不合适。我的想法不会变，祝你一切都好。
note: 对方追问原因时不给清单，一句话说明是合不合适的问题，再把门关上；之后他再发，不必回复。

situation: Went on one date with Priya two weeks ago; she told me all about her Hanoi trip. When she asked about a second one I said 'maybe after my exams, things are crazy', which wasn't really true, I'm just not into it. Now she's texted that exams must be done and asked about Saturday.
reply: Thanks for asking, and I owe you a straighter answer than the one I gave last time. I'm not feeling a romantic connection, so I don't think we should go on a second date. I should have said that at the time instead of blaming exams. I really did enjoy hearing about your Hanoi trip, and I wish you well.
note: When you gave a soft maybe, correct it once and cleanly; owning the dodge in one line beats inventing a new excuse.

situation: Second date with Jonah on Friday and we kissed at the end of the night. Since then I've realised I'm not into him, and today he texted 'Friday was great, same time next week?'. I don't want the kiss to make my no confusing.
reply: Hi Jonah, thanks for Friday, and for the message. I've been thinking since then, and I'm not feeling a romantic connection, so I don't think we should see each other again. I know the end of the night might have said something different, and I'd rather be clear now than let that linger. Take care of yourself.
note: A kiss isn't a promise: name the mixed signal once so the no can't be misread, without explaining or reliving the evening.

situation: I've been seeing Leo casually for about six weeks, maybe eight dates, mostly Sunday mornings at the market. Last night he asked if we could be exclusive. I like him, but I don't see it becoming a relationship, and since he wants more I'd rather end it. We're meeting for coffee Saturday.
reply: Leo, I've been thinking about what you asked the other night, and I want to give you a straight answer. I've really enjoyed these six weeks, especially the Sunday market mornings. But I don't see this becoming a relationship for me, and since you want more, it isn't fair to keep going as we are. So I'd like to end it here. I'm sorry it's not the answer you were hoping for.
note: When someone asks for more, 'let's keep it casual' is the ambiguous option; a clean end respects what he told you he wants.

situation: 我妈的同事王阿姨给我介绍了个男生小刘，加了微信也见了一次面，我没感觉。现在王阿姨发微信问我：“觉得小刘怎么样？他对你印象挺好的。”我不想让王阿姨难做，也不想拖着。
reply: 王阿姨，谢谢您费心张罗，小刘人很有礼貌，那天聊得也挺愉快。不过我对他没有那种感觉，就不继续接触了。我今天也会自己给他发条消息说清楚，不让您夹在中间为难。辛苦您了，改天请您喝茶。
note: 介绍人问起时给明确答案，不说“再看看”；已经直接联系过对方的，自己再跟他说一句。

situation: A coworker, Ryan, asked me out in March and I said no. At last night's team drinks he asked again, saying 'maybe now you've got to know me better.' I'm still not interested and we sit two desks apart. I want to message him privately today.
reply: Hi Ryan, about what you asked last night: my answer is the same as in March, it's a no. I'd rather be clear so neither of us has to wonder. We work well together and I'd like to keep it that way.
note: A second ask gets the same clear no, shorter than the first. If he asks a third time, that's a conversation for your manager or HR, not another message.

situation: 在交友软件上认识一个男生，见过一次面。昨天我礼貌地跟他说没感觉、不继续了，他今天连发了好几条，说我“浪费他时间”“装什么清高”，越说越难听。
reply: 我明白你不高兴。我不会再回复了，就到这里。
note: 对方开始骂人，最多回这一句，也可以一句不回，然后截图留存、拉黑并在软件里举报；如果他出言威胁或找到你的住处、单位，告诉身边的人并报警，情况紧急直接打110。

situation: Went on a first date with Tom on Saturday: tacos, and he told me about his bike trip. It was fine but there was no spark. He's already texted that he bought two tickets for a gig on October 17 and wants to take me.
reply: Thanks for Saturday, Tom, I enjoyed the tacos and hearing about your bike trip. I'm not feeling a romantic connection, though, so I'll pass on the gig on the 17th. Better to say it now so you've got plenty of time to take someone else. Wishing you well.
note: Tickets he bought don't create an obligation; answering quickly is the considerate part, and there's no need to offer to pay.

situation: I've been on two dates with Ben. On the second one last night he told me he'd been laid off on Monday and seemed really low. I'd already decided I'm not feeling it, and now he's asked about Sunday. The timing makes me feel awful.
reply: Hi Ben, thanks for the last two evenings, and for telling me about work; I'm sorry, that's a rough week. I've been thinking, and I'm not feeling a romantic connection, so I'll pass on Sunday. I'd rather say that now than leave you guessing. I really hope the next job comes quickly.
note: Bad timing doesn't make ambiguity kinder: acknowledge the news once, give the clear no, and don't offer friendship as a consolation.

situation: Sou personal trainer no Porto. Um aluno, o Rui, que treina comigo às terças e quintas há três meses, convidou-me ontem para jantar no fim do treino. Não tenho interesse, tenho como regra não sair com alunos e quero continuar a treiná-lo, por isso vou responder por mensagem.
reply: Olá Rui, obrigada pelo convite de ontem. A resposta é não: não sinto uma ligação romântica, e também não saio com alunos. Da minha parte fica tudo igual, vemo-nos na terça como sempre.
note: A regra profissional é uma razão sobre ti, não sobre ele; voltar logo ao treino mostra que nada muda.

situation: 同事介绍的男生，约会了四次，上周我跟他说没感觉，不继续了。他回复说理解，然后问：“那我们还能做朋友吗？”我对他没什么意见，但不想做常联系的朋友。
reply: 谢谢你这么体面地接受，也谢谢你问。说实话，我不打算做常联系的朋友，觉得彼此留点空间更好。祝你一切顺利。
note: 不想做朋友就别答应，把友谊当安慰奖反而是另一种含糊。

situation: On holiday in Lisbon I met Sofia; we spent the last three evenings together and kissed on the final night. For me it was a lovely holiday thing, nothing more. She's back home in Madrid and just texted that she's looking at flights to visit me in London the weekend of Saturday November 14.
reply: Sofia, those three evenings in Lisbon were lovely, and I'm really glad I met you. I want to be honest before you look any further at flights: for me it was a holiday thing, and I'm not feeling a romantic connection beyond that. So I don't think you should come over in November. I'm sorry it's not the answer you were hoping for, and I wish you well.
note: Answer before she books: the clear no now saves her money and a weekend.

situation: I'm Mia, a barista. Owen, a regular who comes in most mornings, left his number on a napkin with 'Dinner sometime?'. I'm not interested, but I'd like him to keep feeling welcome as a customer, and I'd rather text than say it across the counter.
reply: Hi Owen, it's Mia from the café. Thanks for the note, that was kind of you. I don't feel that way about you, so it's a no, but I hope you'll keep coming in for your morning coffee as usual.
note: Where you work, make the no clear and the welcome back normal, then treat him exactly as before. If he keeps asking at the counter, bring in your manager.

situation: Our daughters are best friends in Year 2, and their dad, Chris, asked me at pickup yesterday if I'd like to go for dinner sometime. I'm not interested, but the girls have a playdate at his house every other Saturday and I don't want that to stop. I'd rather text than answer at the school gate.
reply: Hi Chris, thanks for asking yesterday, that was kind of you. I don't see us that way, so it's a no from me, but I'd really like the girls' Saturday playdates to carry on exactly as they are. See you at pickup.
note: When the kids' friendship is the shared ground, keep the no clear and the logistics normal; the playdates are not part of the negotiation.

situation: I'm Joan, 68, and I've been widowed for three years. Gerald from our Tuesday walking group left a card in my letterbox asking me to dinner. I'm not interested in dating anyone again, I'm happy as I am, but I enjoy the walks and want things to stay easy with him there.
reply: Dear Gerald, thank you for your lovely card, it was kind of you to ask. My answer is no: I'm not looking to date again, and I'm genuinely happy as I am. I'd like our Tuesdays to carry on just as they are, so I'll see you on the walk. Joan
note: A reason about yourself is fine when it's true; keep it to one line and make the shared group feel normal straight away.

situation: Ich hatte vor drei Wochen zwei Dates mit Jonas, beide Abende waren nett, aber danach habe ich einfach nicht mehr geantwortet. Heute schreibt er: 'Hab ich was falsch gemacht? Würde es gern wissen.' Ich habe kein Interesse, will mich aber für das Schweigen entschuldigen.
reply: Hallo Jonas, du hast nichts falsch gemacht, und es tut mir leid, dass ich einfach abgetaucht bin. Das war nicht fair von mir. Die beiden Abende waren nett, aber ich spüre keine romantische Verbindung und möchte es nicht weiterführen. Alles Gute für dich.
note: Wer geghostet hat, entschuldigt sich einmal kurz für das Schweigen und sagt dann trotzdem klar nein.

situation: 大学同班的男生阿航昨晚在宿舍楼下跟我表白，还塞给我一副新耳机，大概1200块。我对他没有那种感觉，也不想收这么贵的礼物。我们俩在同一个小组做课程项目，要做到12月。
reply: 阿航，谢谢你昨晚这么认真地跟我说，我知道这需要勇气。不过我对你没有那种感觉，所以我的回答是不。耳机太贵重了，我不能收，明天上课前还给你。小组项目我们照常做，我这部分会按时完成。
note: 贵重礼物一起退回，免得“收了礼物”被当成还有可能；共同的项目照常进行，彼此都不用尴尬。

situation: 先週の合コンで知り合った佐藤さんから、LINEで「今度二人で食事に行きませんか」と誘われました。話は楽しかったけれど、恋愛感情はありません。「忙しくて」と濁すと期待させてしまいそうなので、失礼のないように、でもはっきり断りたいです。
reply: 佐藤さん、先日はありがとうございました。お話しできて楽しかったです。ただ、恋愛としてのお付き合いは考えられないので、二人でのお食事はお断りさせてください。誘っていただけたこと自体は嬉しかったです。
note: 「忙しくて」と濁すのは丁寧に見えても次の誘いを待たせてしまう。言葉は丁寧に、理由は「恋愛として考えられない」の一点だけにする。

situation: My landlord, Martin, lives in the flat downstairs and texted last night asking if I'd like to go for dinner with him on Saturday. I'm not interested at all, and I'm a bit uneasy because my lease runs until next June. I want to say no clearly and keep things strictly about the flat.
reply: Hi Martin, thanks for asking, but it's a no from me. I'd like to keep things between us just landlord and tenant. For anything about the flat, text is the best way to reach me.
note: Where someone has power over your housing, keep the no short and keep a copy of messages; if it continues or affects your tenancy, contact a tenants' advice service, and if you ever feel unsafe, call emergency services.

situation: 我在一个游戏群里认识阿凯两年了，我们和另外三个人每周五晚上一起组队，从没见过面。昨晚他私聊跟我表白，说想下个月来杭州见我。我对他没有那种感觉，但很想继续每周五一起打游戏。
reply: 阿凯，谢谢你跟我说这些，我知道说出口不容易。不过我对你没有那种感觉，所以下个月就不见面了，免得你白跑一趟。这两年周五晚上一起组队我真的很开心，如果你愿意，我们照常一起玩；你想先缓几周也完全没关系。
note: 网友表白：在对方订行程前说清楚；只有真心想继续一起玩才提照常组队，并给他退一步的空间。

situation: I'm Ava. Last night Jake from my running club commented publicly under my race photo on Instagram: 'Great run! Dinner with me to celebrate? 😊'. About 30 club members follow me, and we run together every Wednesday. I'm not interested and want to say no privately without leaving his comment hanging.
reply: Hi Jake, thanks for the comment and the invite, that was kind of you. I'm going to say no, though: I don't see us that way. I'll just reply with a thank you under the photo so it doesn't sit there, and I'll see you at Wednesday's run as usual.
note: Asked out in public: give the real answer privately and only a neutral thanks in public, so he isn't turned down in front of the club.

situation: I've been on three dates with Alex, the last one on Saturday. This morning he texted 'I think I'm falling for you, I've never felt like this so fast.' I like him as a person, but I'm not feeling a romantic connection and I want to end it kindly by text.
reply: Alex, thank you for telling me how you feel, that took courage. I don't feel the same way. I've enjoyed our three dates and you've been lovely company, but I'm not feeling a romantic connection, so I'd like to stop seeing each other. I'm sorry it's not the answer you were hoping for, and I wish you well.
note: When their feelings run far ahead of yours, answer the declaration directly and quickly; a slow fade after 'I'm falling for you' is the cruel option.

situation: Nina from my Monday pottery class asked me out for a drink after class last night. I'm straight, so it's a no, but I like her, and we share a table every week until December. I'd rather text than make it a thing in class.
reply: Hi Nina, thanks for asking last night, that was really kind. I'm straight, so it's a no from me, but I'm glad you felt you could ask. See you at our table on Monday, same as always.
note: A reason about who you are is a complete answer: say it once, without apology, and make the shared class feel normal straight away.
